description: The Drommedaris guards the Oude Haven at Enkhuizen: a large round brick tower with a steep slate roof and a small bell cupola, joined by an arched water gate to a smaller half-round tower. Dark harbour water fills the foreground. The sky is overcast, about 14.7°C, with wind near 5.0 km/h. This is not the Zuiderzeemuseum village. No inscription is readable.
